paragraph:
# Velmoria's contagion

*One hundred and sixty years on, an epidemic tests whether science, (ethics), and self-rule can hold together under strain*

LET THIS chapter open in the (throes) of a public health crisis. One hundred and sixty years after the marshal fell, Velmoria was struck by an epidemic that swept its great (metropolis) and spread to the rural (environs) beyond—a viral (nemesis) that left the public health system in (shambles) and the republic's nerve under its severest test in a generation. How a free people meet a contagion, the (annals) would record, reveals their (ethos) as surely as any war.

The disease itself baffled the (specifics) that medicine usually relies upon—the clear markers, the predictable course. It began with a (gastritis)-like complaint, progressed to inflammation of the liver resembling (hepatitis), and in severe cases attacked the kidneys with a fierce (nephritis). Some survivors were left with a lingering (arthritis) in the joints; a few, with damage to the (pancreas) that no (dietetics) could fully repair. The (prognosis), at first, was grim. The genetics of the virus shifted faster than laboratories could fully (canvass) its mutations, and every (hypothesis) about its spread seemed to dissolve within weeks.

The republic's response drew on a century and a half of institutional strength. Its medical (facilities), though strained, did not collapse. Specialists in (pediatrics) tended the youngest; experts in (genetics) raced to sequence the pathogen; logisticians applied the cold (mechanics) of (logistics) to the distribution of care. The work demanded a difficult (synthesis)—the (thesis) of public safety set against the (antithesis) of personal liberty, reconciled not by decree but by debate. There was no (stasis); the situation demanded constant adjustment, a kind of social (homeostasis) maintained by deliberate effort.

Recall how the marshal would have handled a plague. He would have ruled by (fracas) and fear, sealing the (metropolis) behind locked (blinds) and armed (palings), letting the poor (devour) the (dregs) while his cronies hoarded the (viands). He would have made a (martyr) of any doctor who told the truth and an (apotheosis) of himself as savior. His public health would have been pure theatre—a (précis) of lies, a (synopsis) of false hope, the (hubris) of a man who believed his will could (surpass) a virus. To question his (prognosis) would have been to (harass) the state.

The republic, (chasten)ed by that memory, refused both the marshal's (hubris) and the opposite error of (doldrums)-bound inaction. It published the hard (specifics)—the (odds) of infection, the real (prognosis), the (minutes) of every emergency council meeting—without (ellipsis) or evasive gloss. The public was treated as adult citizens, not children to be soothed. There were (qualms), of course; there was (pathos) in the daily count of the lost. But the (ethos) of candor held. Trust, built over generations, proved the republic's truest (aegis).

The crisis tested the republic's (ethics) at every turn. Who should receive the scarce treatment first—by (lottery), by need, by the (calipers) of cold utility? The debate raged in the (forum) and the press, a vigorous (canvass) of competing values. Some argued from (metaphysics) and (homiletics), invoking the sanctity of every life; others from the (mechanics) of triage, the grim (logistics) of saving the most. The republic did not resolve it by (fiat). It built, through painful debate, a (synthesis) the public could accept—a (thesis) refined against its (antithesis) until something workable emerged.

Science, meanwhile, did its patient work. Researchers studied the virus's (symbiosis) with its hosts, the (osmosis) of infection across membranes, the way it breached the (epidermis) of immunity. A breakthrough came not from any lone genius but from the (symbiosis) of many minds—a collaboration of disciplines. Scholars of (linguistics) helped interpret historical records of earlier outbreaks, while specialists in (aeronautics) modeled airborne spread. The (genesis) of the cure was a thousand small advances of honest research, whose (proceeds) were pooled and shared (gratis) across every laboratory. There was no (hoarding), no (patent)-driven (morass).

The strain told on the public spirit. Profiteers tried to (harass) the desperate, selling fake (elixir)s and worthless paper dressed up as (securities) against future infection. A (crass) populist tried to spur a (fracas)—to blame a minority, to (embarrass) the health authorities, to (devour) the public's fear for his own gain. He spread a (neurosis) of conspiracy, a (hubris)-laden claim that the epidemic was a plot. But the republic, alert to how readily such demagoguery corrodes a community's (mores), did not let him (surpass) the bounds of decency. His lies found scads of credulous ears at first, then dwindled to the (dregs) of the fringe.

Slowly, the tide turned. The cure took hold; the (prognosis) brightened; the (throes) of the epidemic eased into a long convalescence. The (metropolis), once a (shambles), began to (canvass) public accounts of its losses and bury its dead—not in the marshal's grand (necropolis) of self-glory, but in quiet graves, each marked with care. The survivors emerged into a kind of (catharsis), a national grief that, shared honestly, became a source of cohesion rather than (fracas). Like an insect after its (ecdysis), the republic shed an old skin and found itself, scarred but whole.

Beyond the crisis, ordinary life slowly resumed its (mechanics). The (rapids) above the city ran clean; a (zephyr) carried the smell of recovery through the (environs). A ceramicist returned to her (ceramics); a carpenter swept the (shavings) and (filings) from his floor and hung his (tongs) and (pliers), his (nippers) and (calipers), back on the wall. Children returned to (athletics) and (orthodontics) appointments; an old man's (rabies)-wary dog chased a stick past the (bleachers) of the empty stadium. A street vendor laid out his (viands); a (bourgeois) couple strolled the market; the (verdigris) on the old fountain caught the light. The belongings of the lost were gathered with tenderness; their (remains) honored; their (annals) recorded.

The republic earned (kudos), even from abroad, for its handling of the plague—not because it was flawless, but because it was honest. Its (compass) had held true. It had refused the marshal's (hubris) and the demagogue's (fracas) alike; it had let science, (ethics), and self-rule (encompass) the crisis together. The (apotheosis) of the response was not a leader but a method: the patient (synthesis) of competing goods by a free people who trusted one another enough to (canvass) hard truths.

The episode entered the national (annals) as a (synopsis) of the republic's enduring (ethos). A free society, the historians wrote, is tested not only by tyrants but by plagues, panics, and the slow (morass) of fear—and its (aegis) in such times is neither a strongman's will nor a (martyr)'s sacrifice, but the unglamorous (mechanics) of honest institutions, the (osmosis) of trust between citizens, the refusal to let (hubris) or (crass) demagoguery (surpass) the bounds of truth. To meet a contagion with candor, the lesson ran, is itself a kind of (valor).

So Velmoria, one hundred and sixty years free, learns that the gravest threats may come as a virus rather than a (coup)—and that the answer to a plague is the same as the answer to a tyrant: not the (hubris) of a single will, but the patient (synthesis) of many, the honest (précis) of hard facts, the steady (homeostasis) of a society that governs itself through its (throes). The marshal would have made a plague his (apotheosis), hoarding the (viands) and making a (martyr) of the truth-teller; his country, a century and a half and more past his fall, has chosen the (converse)—to face the contagion with open (blinds), shared (proceeds), and the quiet (kudos)-worthy courage of a free people who refuse, even in their darkest (throes), to surrender the (compass) of their own self-rule.

quiz.question: ____ _ detour
quiz.explanation: 绕道; 迂回, 绕道. We had to take a detour because of road construction. 我们不得不绕道,因为道路施工。 | de->离开，tour->转/旅行（法语），detour->转离原路=绕道（cf. tour旅游，contour轮廓） || 文化联想：中国城市修路时司机常被迫绕行，最适合帮助记忆 detour，可以说 **take a detour — “When a road is closed for construction, a driver may have to take a detour through nearby streets.”**

quiz.question: devour _ ____
quiz.explanation: 吞食; 狼吞虎咽, 一口气读完一本书. She would devour a book in a single sitting. 她会一口气读完一本书。 | de->彻底，vour->吞食（拉丁vorare），devour->彻底吞噬（cf. voracious贪吃的，carnivore肉食动物） || 文化联想：中文“废寝忘食地一口气读完”最适合帮助记忆 devour，可以说 **devour a book — “A reader fascinated by a wuxia novel may devour a book in one sitting and forget the time completely.”**

quiz.question: spur ______
quiz.explanation: 马刺; 刺激, 刺激增长. Tax incentives can spur growth in the economy. 税收优惠可以刺激经济增长。 | spur->马刺（古英语spura），spur->像马刺一样刺激=激励（cf. spurn用脚踢开，on the spur of the moment一时冲动） || 文化联想：中文“政策刺激经济增长”最适合帮助记忆 spur，可以说 **spur growth — “Investment in transport and technology can spur growth by improving productivity and creating new demand.”**

quiz.question: ______ zephyr
quiz.explanation: 和风; 微风, 春天的微风. A gentle spring zephyr rustled the leaves. 轻柔的春天微风吹动树叶。 | Zephyros->西风之神（希腊神话），zephyr->轻柔的西风/微风 || 文化联想：江南春天柳枝轻摆的和风最适合帮助记忆 zephyr，可以说 **a spring zephyr — “A gentle spring zephyr may ripple the surface of West Lake and stir the willow branches.”**

quiz.question: _________ martyr
quiz.explanation: 殉道者; 烈士, 基督教殉道者. The Christian martyr died for his faith. 基督教殉道者为信仰而死。 | martyr->见证者（希腊martys->证人），martyr->用生命见证信仰的人=殉道者 || 文化联想：martyr 在这里是基督教“殉道者”，可用中国学生学习宗教史时来记忆，可以说 **a Christian martyr — “In a history-of-religion class, students may learn about a Christian martyr who died rather than renounce the faith.”**

quiz.question: ______ fracas
quiz.explanation: 喧闹; 吵闹, 街头喧闹. A street fracas broke out between rival groups. 对立团体之间爆发了街头喧闹。 | fracasser->打碎（法语），fracas->打碎东西的喧闹=吵闹冲突（cf. fracture骨折，fragile易碎的） || 文化联想：中文“街头发生一场吵闹冲突”最适合帮助记忆 fracas，可以说 **a street fracas — “A minor argument outside a restaurant can turn into a street fracas if several people begin shouting and pushing.”**

quiz.question: pancreas ________
quiz.explanation: 胰腺, 胰腺功能. Diabetes affects pancreas function significantly. 糖尿病严重影响胰腺功能。 | pan->全部，kreas->肉（希腊），pancreas->全是肉的=胰腺（cf. pandemic全球性的） || 文化联想：中国医院内分泌科检查胰腺功能最适合帮助记忆 pancreas，可以说 **pancreas function — “Doctors may evaluate pancreas function when a patient has problems with blood sugar or digestion.”**

quiz.question: ___ specifics
quiz.explanation: 具体细节, 具体细节. Let us discuss the specifics of the proposal. 让我们讨论提案的具体细节。 | spec->看/具体（拉丁species->种类），specifics->具体细节（cf. species物种，specimen样本） || 文化联想：中文“别泛泛而谈，讲具体细节”最适合帮助记忆 specifics，可以说 **the specifics — “Before signing a contract, a buyer should ask about the specifics of price, deadlines, and responsibilities.”**

quiz.question: ____________ ethics
quiz.explanation: 伦理学; 道德规范, 职业道德. Doctors must adhere to professional ethics standards. 医生必须遵守职业道德标准。 | ethos->品格/气质（希腊），ethics->关于品格的学问=伦理学（cf. ethnic民族的） || 文化联想：中文“职业道德”最适合帮助记忆 ethics，可以说 **professional ethics — “Doctors, lawyers, and engineers are expected to follow professional ethics even when doing so is inconvenient.”**

quiz.question: ____ ceramics
quiz.explanation: 陶瓷, 精美陶瓷. The museum displays ancient fine ceramics from China. 博物馆展示来自中国的古代精美陶瓷。 | keramos->陶土（希腊），ceramics->陶土制品=陶瓷 || 文化联想：景德镇瓷器最适合帮助记忆 ceramics，可以说 **fine ceramics — “A museum exhibition may display fine ceramics from Jingdezhen with delicate glaze and painted decoration.”**

quiz.question: _______ mechanics
quiz.explanation: 力学; 机械学, 量子力学. Physicists study quantum mechanics at the subatomic level. 物理学家研究亚原子层面的量子力学。 | mechane->机器（希腊），mechanics->研究机器/力的学问=力学（cf. machine机器，mechanism机制） || 文化联想：中国大学物理课学习量子力学最适合帮助记忆 mechanics，可以说 **quantum mechanics — “A physics student may study quantum mechanics to understand matter and energy at very small scales.”**

quiz.question: _____ mnemonics
quiz.explanation: 记忆术, 学习记忆术. Students use study mnemonics to memorize information. 学生使用学习记忆术来记忆信息。 | Mnemosyne->记忆女神（希腊神话），mnemonics->记忆的技术=记忆术（注意m不发音，cf. amnesia失忆症） || 文化联想：中文学生用“谐音口诀”背知识最适合帮助记忆 mnemonics，可以说 **study mnemonics — “A student may create study mnemonics with rhymes or word associations to remember difficult vocabulary.”**

quiz.question: pediatrics ____
quiz.explanation: 儿科学, 儿科病房. The hospital opened a new pediatrics ward last month. 医院上个月开设了新的儿科病房。 | ped->儿童（希腊pais），iatrics->医疗，pediatrics->儿童医疗=儿科 || 文化联想：中国儿童医院的儿科病房最适合帮助记忆 pediatrics，可以说 **a pediatrics ward — “A children’s hospital may open a new pediatrics ward designed specifically for young patients.”**

quiz.question: _____ metaphysics
quiz.explanation: 形而上学, 学习形而上学. Philosophy students study metaphysics in their second year. 哲学系学生在第二年学习形而上学。 | meta->之后/超越，physics->物理学，metaphysics->物理学之后的学问（亚里士多德著作的编排顺序） || 文化联想：中国大学哲学系学习“形而上学”最适合帮助记忆 metaphysics，可以说 **study metaphysics — “Philosophy students may study metaphysics when discussing existence, causation, identity, and reality.”**

quiz.question: _______ athletics
quiz.explanation: 田径运动, 大学田径运动. College athletics programs attract talented athletes nationwide. 大学田径运动项目吸引了全国有才华的运动员。 | athlos->竞赛（希腊），athletics->竞技运动（cf. athlete运动员，pentathlon五项全能） || 文化联想：中国大学里的田径队最适合帮助记忆 athletics，可以说 **college athletics — “A university may support college athletics through track, basketball, swimming, and other competitive sports.”**

quiz.question: _____ homiletics
quiz.explanation: 讲道学, 学习讲道学. Seminary students learn homiletics as part of their training. 神学院学生在培训中学习讲道学。 | homilos->人群（希腊），homiletics->向人群讲道的学问（cf. homily布道） || 文化联想：homiletics 是基督教“讲道学”，可用中国神学院课程来记忆，可以说 **learn homiletics — “A seminary student in China may learn homiletics to prepare and deliver clear, structured sermons.”**

quiz.question: _____ genetics
quiz.explanation: 遗传学, 学习遗传学. Biologists study genetics to understand heredity. 生物学家学习遗传学以理解遗传。 | genesis->起源/产生（希腊），genetics->研究遗传起源的学问=遗传学（cf. gene基因） || 文化联想：中国高中和大学生物课里的遗传学最适合帮助记忆 genetics，可以说 **study genetics — “Biology students study genetics to understand how traits are inherited and how genes vary.”**

quiz.question: ________ dietetics
quiz.explanation: 营养学, 临床营养学. She earned a degree in clinical dietetics. 她获得了临床营养学学位。 | diaita->生活方式（希腊），dietetics->研究饮食方式的学问=营养学（cf. diet饮食） || 文化联想：中国医院营养科的临床营养学最适合帮助记忆 dietetics，可以说 **clinical dietetics — “A hospital dietitian may use clinical dietetics to design meals for patients with specific medical needs.”**

quiz.question: orthodontics _________
quiz.explanation: 正畸学, 正畸治疗. The teenager needs orthodontics treatment for crooked teeth. 这个青少年的歪牙需要正畸治疗。 | ortho->直/正，dont->牙（希腊odous），orthodontics->使牙齿变直的学问=正畸学 || 文化联想：戴牙套矫正牙齿是最直观的 orthodontics 场景，可以说 **orthodontics treatment — “A teenager with crowded teeth may receive orthodontics treatment using braces or aligners.”**

quiz.question: ______ logistics
quiz.explanation: 物流; 后勤, 供应物流. The company improved its supply logistics system. 公司改进了其供应物流系统。 | logistique->军队补给（法语），logistics->军队物资调配=后勤/物流（cf. logic逻辑） || 文化联想：中国电商和快递网络最适合帮助记忆 logistics，可以说 **supply logistics — “A large online retailer depends on efficient supply logistics to move goods from warehouses to customers quickly.”**

quiz.question: _____ linguistics
quiz.explanation: 语言学, 学习语言学. Students study linguistics to understand language structure. 学生学习语言学以理解语言结构。 | lingua->舌头/语言（拉丁），linguistics->研究语言的学问=语言学（cf. bilingual双语的） || 文化联想：中国学生研究普通话、方言和语法最适合帮助记忆 linguistics，可以说 **study linguistics — “A university student may study linguistics to compare Mandarin, regional dialects, and patterns of language structure.”**

quiz.question: _____ aeronautics
quiz.explanation: 航空学, 航空学. He studied aeronautics at the engineering school. 他在工程学院专攻航空学。 | aero->空气（希腊aer），naut->航行者，aeronautics->在空气中航行的学问=航空学（cf. astronaut宇航员，nautical航海的） || 文化联想：中国航空航天大学里的航空学最适合帮助记忆 aeronautics，可以说 **study aeronautics — “An engineering student may study aeronautics to learn how aircraft generate lift, stability, and control.”**

quiz.question: scads __ _____
quiz.explanation: 大量, 大量金钱. The lottery winner received scads of money. 彩票中奖者获得了大量金钱。 | scads->大量，scads of->大量的 || 文化联想：中文“赚得盆满钵满”最适合帮助记忆 scads，可以说 **scads of money — “A wildly successful holiday film may earn scads of money at the box office.”**

quiz.question: ____ odds
quiz.explanation: 可能性; 几率, 很小的可能性. Despite the long odds, they succeeded in their mission. 尽管可能性很小,他们还是完成了任务。 | odds->差异/比值（古英语），odds->赔率/可能性（at odds->不一致） || 文化联想：中文“希望渺茫但还是成功了”最适合帮助记忆 odds，可以说 **long odds — “A small startup facing giant competitors may succeed despite the long odds.”**

quiz.question: _______ proceeds
quiz.explanation: 收益; 收入, 拍卖收益. The auction proceeds will benefit the charity. 拍卖收益将用于慈善事业。 | pro->向前，ceed->走（拉丁cedere），proceeds->向前走得到的=收益（cf. proceed进行） || 文化联想：公益拍卖所得全部捐给慈善机构最适合帮助记忆 proceeds，可以说 **auction proceeds — “The auction proceeds from donated artwork may be given to a rural education charity.”**

quiz.question: _____ rapids
quiz.explanation: 急流, 河流急流. Kayakers navigated the dangerous river rapids. 皮划艇运动员穿越危险的河流急流。 | rapid->快速（拉丁rapidus），rapids->水流快速的地方=急流 || 文化联想：虎跳峡湍急河段最适合帮助记忆 rapids，可以说 **river rapids — “Rafters entering a narrow mountain gorge may encounter powerful river rapids after heavy rain.”**

quiz.question: _________ viands
quiz.explanation: 食品; 佳肴, 美味佳肴. The banquet table was laden with delicious viands. 宴会桌上摆满了美味佳肴。 | vivanda->维持生命之物（拉丁vivere->生活），viands->维持生命的食物=佳肴（cf. vivid生动的，vitamin维生素） || 文化联想：春节或婚宴上一桌丰盛佳肴最适合帮助记忆 viands，可以说 **delicious viands — “A traditional banquet may cover the round table with delicious viands ranging from fish to roast meats and vegetables.”**

quiz.question: ______ blinds
quiz.explanation: 百叶窗, 窗户百叶窗. Close the window blinds to block out the sunlight. 关上窗户百叶窗遮挡阳光。 | blind->遮蔽（古英语），blinds->遮挡光线的窗帘=百叶窗 || 文化联想：中国家庭窗户上的百叶帘最适合帮助记忆 blinds，可以说 **window blinds — “A homeowner may close the window blinds in the afternoon to reduce glare and heat.”**

quiz.question: _____ auspices
quiz.explanation: 赞助; 支持, 在...赞助下. The event was held under auspices of the United Nations. 活动在联合国的赞助下举行。 | avis->鸟，spic->看（拉丁），auspices->观鸟占卜=吉兆/赞助（cf. auspicious吉祥的） || 文化联想：中文“在某机构支持下举办”最适合帮助记忆 auspices，可以说 **under the auspices of — “A cultural exhibition may be held under the auspices of a university or public museum.”**

quiz.question: rabies _______
quiz.explanation: 狂犬病, 狂犬病疫苗. The dog received a rabies vaccine at the vet. 狗在兽医那里接种了狂犬病疫苗。 | rabere->发狂（拉丁），rabies->使发狂的病=狂犬病（cf. rabid狂热的，rage狂怒） || 文化联想：中国养狗家庭接种狂犬疫苗最适合帮助记忆 rabies，可以说 **a rabies vaccine — “A responsible dog owner takes the pet to a veterinarian for a rabies vaccine on schedule.”**

quiz.question: ______ facilities
quiz.explanation: 设施, 体育设施. The university built new sports facilities for students. 大学为学生建造了新的体育设施。 | facilis->容易的（拉丁facere->做），facilities->方便做事的设备=设施（cf. facilitate便利） || 文化联想：中国大学新建体育馆、游泳馆等设施最适合帮助记忆 facilities，可以说 **sports facilities — “A university may build new sports facilities including courts, a track, and a swimming pool.”**

quiz.question: _____ securities
quiz.explanation: 证券, 交易证券. Brokers trade securities on the stock exchange. 经纪人在证券交易所交易证券。 | securus->安全（拉丁），securities->安全投资凭证=证券 || 文化联想：中国投资者在交易所买卖股票债券最适合帮助记忆 securities，可以说 **trade securities — “An investor may trade securities such as stocks and bonds through a brokerage account.”**

quiz.question: __ shambles
quiz.explanation: 混乱; 废墟, 一片混乱. After the storm, the town was in shambles. 暴风雨过后,城镇一片混乱。 | shambles->原指凌乱的肉市，现指一片狼藉 || 文化联想：中文“一片狼藉”最适合帮助记忆 shambles，可以说 **in shambles — “After a severe typhoon, a market street may be in shambles with signs, branches, and debris everywhere.”**

quiz.question: __ ___ throes __
quiz.explanation: 阵痛; 痛苦挣扎, 在...痛苦挣扎中. The nation is in the throes of economic crisis. 这个国家正处于经济危机的痛苦挣扎中。 | throes->剧烈阵痛（古英语thrawu->痛苦），in the throes of->正处于...的剧烈挣扎中 || 文化联想：中文“正处在危机最痛苦的阶段”最适合帮助记忆 throes，可以说 **in the throes of — “A company in the throes of a major restructuring may face layoffs, uncertainty, and constant change.”**

quiz.question: ______ mores
quiz.explanation: 风俗; 习惯, 社会习俗. Every culture has its own social mores and customs. 每种文化都有自己的社会习俗。 | mores->风俗（拉丁mos->习惯），mores->社会道德习俗（cf. moral道德的） || 文化联想：中国人情社会中的“礼尚往来”等习俗很适合帮助记忆 mores，可以说 **social mores — “Customs surrounding gift-giving and reciprocity can reflect the social mores of a community.”**

quiz.question: ______ tresses
quiz.explanation: 长发; 辫子, 金色长发. The princess was known for her golden tresses. 公主以其金色长发而闻名。 | tresse->编发（古法语，来自希腊tricha->三股），tresses->编成的长发 || 文化联想：古装剧里公主披着长发的形象最适合帮助记忆 tresses，可以说 **long tresses — “A costume drama may portray a princess with long tresses flowing down her back.”**

quiz.question: _______ minutes
quiz.explanation: 会议记录, 会议记录. The secretary took careful meeting minutes. 秘书仔细记录了会议记录。 | minuta->小的书写（拉丁），minutes->小字记录=会议记录（cf. minute微小的/分钟，minutiae细节） || 文化联想：中国公司开会后整理会议纪要最适合帮助记忆 minutes，可以说 **meeting minutes — “A secretary may circulate the meeting minutes so everyone knows the decisions and assigned actions.”**

quiz.question: ___ dregs __ _______
quiz.explanation: 渣滓; 糟粕, 社会渣滓. The criminal was considered the dregs of society. 这个罪犯被认为是社会渣滓。 | dregs->沉渣（古挪威dregg），dregs->底部沉积物=渣滓 || 文化联想：中文“社会渣滓”最适合帮助记忆 dregs，可以说 **the dregs of society — “A violent criminal who repeatedly exploits vulnerable people may be condemned as part of the dregs of society.”**

quiz.question: ________ belongings
quiz.explanation: 所有物; 财物, 个人财物. Please collect your personal belongings before leaving. 离开前请收拾您的个人财物。 | belong->属于（be+long），belongings->属于某人的东西=所有物 || 文化联想：搬家前打包自己的个人物品最适合帮助记忆 belongings，可以说 **personal belongings — “Before leaving a rented apartment, a tenant should collect all personal belongings.”**

quiz.question: ______ palings
quiz.explanation: 栅栏; 围栏, 木栅栏. The garden was enclosed by wooden palings. 花园被木栅栏围起来。 | pale->木桩（拉丁palus->桩），palings->木桩围成的栅栏（cf. palisade栅栏） || 文化联想：中国乡村菜园周围的木栅栏最适合帮助记忆 palings，可以说 **wooden palings — “A small vegetable garden may be enclosed by wooden palings to keep animals out.”**

quiz.question: _____ filings
quiz.explanation: 锉屑, 金属锉屑. Metal filings scattered across the workshop floor. 金属锉屑散落在车间地板上。 | file->锉（古英语feol），filings->锉下来的屑=锉屑 || 文化联想：机加工车间地上的金属锉屑最适合帮助记忆 filings，可以说 **metal filings — “A machinist may sweep up metal filings after shaping a steel part with a file.”**

quiz.question: ____ shavings
quiz.explanation: 刨花, 木刨花. Wood shavings covered the carpenteras bench. 木刨花覆盖了木匠的工作台。 | shave->刮/刨（古英语scafan），shavings->刨去的碎屑=刨花 || 文化联想：传统木匠刨木板时落下的木刨花最适合帮助记忆 shavings，可以说 **wood shavings — “A carpenter’s bench may be covered with curled wood shavings after planing a board.”**

quiz.question: _______ tongs
quiz.explanation: 钳子; 夹子, 厨房夹子. Use the kitchen tongs to handle hot items. 用厨房夹子处理热的物品。 | tang->夹（古英语tang），tongs->夹取工具=夹子（cf. tongue舌头，同词根，舌头像钳子） || 文化联想：中国厨房夹热饺子或烤肉时用夹子最适合帮助记忆 tongs，可以说 **kitchen tongs — “A cook may use kitchen tongs to turn hot food without touching it by hand.”**

quiz.question: _____ précis
quiz.explanation: 摘要; 概要, 简短摘要. The student wrote a brief précis of the article. 学生写了一篇文章的简短摘要。 | précis->精确简短（法语，来自拉丁praecisus->切短），précis->简洁摘要（cf. precise精确的） || 文化联想：中文“把文章压缩成短摘要”最适合帮助记忆 précis，可以说 **a brief précis — “A student may write a brief précis that captures the central argument of a long article in only a few sentences.”**

quiz.question: ________ proboscis
quiz.explanation: 鼻子; 长鼻, 大象鼻子. The elephant proboscis is a versatile tool. 大象鼻子是一个多功能工具。 | pro->向前，bosk->喂食（希腊），proboscis->伸向前方采食的器官=长鼻 || 文化联想：云南野象的长鼻最适合帮助记忆 proboscis，可以说 **an elephant proboscis — “An Asian elephant uses its proboscis to smell, drink, grasp food, and move objects.”**

quiz.question: _____ ___ aegis
quiz.explanation: 保护; 赞助, 在...保护下. The project operates under the aegis of the government. 该项目在政府的保护下运作。 | Aigis->宙斯的神盾（希腊神话），aegis->神盾的保护=庇护 || 文化联想：中文“在某机构庇护或支持下”最适合帮助记忆 aegis，可以说 **under the aegis of — “A research program may operate under the aegis of a national scientific institution.”**

quiz.question: _____ necropolis
quiz.explanation: 墓地; 公墓, 皇家墓地. Archaeologists excavated the royal necropolis. 考古学家挖掘了皇家墓地。 | necro->死亡（希腊nekros），polis->城市，necropolis->死者之城=墓地（cf. necromancy死灵术） || 文化联想：十三陵等大型皇家陵墓群最适合帮助记忆 necropolis，可以说 **a royal necropolis — “A large imperial burial complex can be described as a royal necropolis containing tombs built for rulers and their families.”**

quiz.question: ________ metropolis
quiz.explanation: 大都市, 繁华的大都市. New York is a bustling metropolis with millions of residents. 纽约是一个拥有数百万居民的繁华大都市。 | metro->母亲，polis->城市，metropolis->母城=大都市 || 文化联想：上海最适合帮助记忆 metropolis，可以说 **a bustling metropolis — “Shanghai is a bustling metropolis filled with dense neighborhoods, offices, transit lines, and millions of residents.”**

quiz.question: _____ epidermis
quiz.explanation: 表皮, 外表皮. The outer epidermis protects the body from infection. 外表皮保护身体免受感染。 | epi->在上，dermis->皮肤（希腊），epidermis->在皮肤上面的=表皮（cf. dermatology皮肤科） || 文化联想：中国生物课里皮肤最外层最适合帮助记忆 epidermis，可以说 **the outer epidermis — “The outer epidermis forms a protective barrier between the body and the environment.”**

quiz.question: bourgeois _____
quiz.explanation: 资产阶级的; 中产阶级的, 资产阶级. The bourgeois class emerged during the industrial revolution. 资产阶级在工业革命期间兴起。 | bourg->城镇（法语），bourgeois->城镇居民=中产阶级 || 文化联想：中文历史和社会学课讨论“资产阶级”最适合帮助记忆 bourgeois，可以说 **the bourgeois class — “In a history lesson on industrialization, students may discuss the rise of the bourgeois class in growing commercial cities.”**

quiz.question: _____ debris
quiz.explanation: 碎片; 残骸, 暴风雨残骸. Storm debris littered the streets after the hurricane. 飓风过后,暴风雨残骸散落在街道上。 | débriser->打碎（法语），debris->打碎后的碎片=残骸（注意s不发音） || 文化联想：台风过后街道上的树枝和碎片最适合帮助记忆 debris，可以说 **storm debris — “After a typhoon, workers may clear storm debris such as broken branches, signs, and roof tiles from the roads.”**

quiz.question: _____ hubris
quiz.explanation: 傲慢; 狂妄, 致命的傲慢. His fatal hubris led to his downfall. 他致命的傲慢导致了他的垮台。 | hubris->傲慢/冒犯神灵（希腊），hubris->在希腊悲剧中导致英雄毁灭的致命傲慢（cf. Nemesis报应） || 文化联想：中文“骄兵必败”最适合帮助记忆 hubris，可以说 **fatal hubris — “A leader who believes defeat is impossible may fall through fatal hubris—很像‘骄兵必败.’”**

quiz.question: _____ verdigris
quiz.explanation: 铜绿, 绿色铜绿. Green verdigris formed on the old copper statue. 古老的铜像上形成了绿色铜绿。 | verd->绿（法语vert），verdigris->希腊绿=铜绿 || 文化联想：故宫铜器或老铜像表面的绿色铜锈最适合帮助记忆 verdigris，可以说 **green verdigris — “An old bronze ornament exposed to air and moisture may develop a layer of green verdigris.”**

quiz.question: _________ stasis
quiz.explanation: 停滞; 静止, 政治停滞. The country experienced political stasis for years. 该国经历了多年的政治停滞。 | stasis->站立/停止（希腊histanai->使站立），stasis->停滞不动（cf. static静态的，ecstasy狂喜） || 文化联想：中文“多年停滞不前”最适合帮助记忆 stasis，可以说 **political stasis — “When rival factions block every major decision, a government may fall into political stasis.”**

quiz.question: ________ homeostasis
quiz.explanation: 体内平衡, 维持体内平衡. The body works to maintain homeostasis constantly. 身体不断努力维持体内平衡。 | homeo->相同（希腊），stasis->静止，homeostasis->保持相同状态=体内平衡 || 文化联想：人体维持体温、血糖和酸碱平衡最适合帮助记忆 homeostasis，可以说 **maintain homeostasis — “The human body constantly adjusts temperature, fluids, and chemistry to maintain homeostasis.”**

quiz.question: ________ thesis
quiz.explanation: 论文, 博士论文. She defended her doctoral thesis successfully. 她成功地为博士论文进行了答辩。 | thesis->放置/主张（希腊tithenai->放置），thesis->放置出来的主张=论文（cf. antithesis对立，synthesis综合） || 文化联想：中国博士生毕业前写博士论文最适合帮助记忆 thesis，可以说 **a doctoral thesis — “A PhD candidate may spend several years researching and writing a doctoral thesis before the defense.”**

quiz.question: _______ antithesis
quiz.explanation: 对立; 对立面, 完全对立. His behavior was the perfect antithesis of professionalism. 他的行为与职业精神完全对立。 | anti->对，thesis->主张，antithesis->对立的主张=对立面 || 文化联想：中文“完全是反面教材”最适合帮助记忆 antithesis，可以说 **the perfect antithesis — “A manager who hides mistakes and blames others is the perfect antithesis of transparent leadership.”**

quiz.question: _______ synthesis
quiz.explanation: 综合; 合成, 蛋白质合成. Cells carry out protein synthesis using ribosomes. 细胞使用核糖体进行蛋白质合成。 | syn->共同，thesis->放置，synthesis->放在一起=综合/合成（cf. photosynthesis光合作用） || 文化联想：高中生物课学习蛋白质合成最适合帮助记忆 synthesis，可以说 **protein synthesis — “Inside a cell, ribosomes carry out protein synthesis by assembling amino acids according to genetic instructions.”**

quiz.question: _____ photosynthesis
quiz.explanation: 光合作用, 植物光合作用. Plant photosynthesis converts sunlight into energy. 植物光合作用将阳光转化为能量。 | photo->光，synthesis->合成，photosynthesis->用光合成=光合作用 || 文化联想：中国中学生物课里的光合作用最适合帮助记忆 photosynthesis，可以说 **plant photosynthesis — “Through plant photosynthesis, green leaves use light energy to make sugars from carbon dioxide and water.”**

quiz.question: __________ hypothesis
quiz.explanation: 假设; 假说, 科学假设. The researcher tested her scientific hypothesis through experiments. 研究人员通过实验检验了她的科学假设。 | hypo->在下，thesis->放置，hypothesis->放在下面的基础假设 || 文化联想：中文“先提出假设，再做实验验证”最适合帮助记忆 hypothesis，可以说 **a scientific hypothesis — “A researcher may test a scientific hypothesis by designing an experiment that could prove it wrong.”**

quiz.question: Nemesis ______
quiz.explanation: 复仇女神; 宿敌, 宿敌人物. The detective finally confronted his Nemesis figure. 侦探最终面对了他的宿敌人物。 | Nemesis->希腊复仇女神（执行对傲慢者的惩罚），nemesis->报复/宿敌（对应hubris傲慢） || 文化联想：Nemesis 是希腊神话中的复仇女神，也引申为宿敌；可用中国学生读希腊神话时来记忆，可以说 **a Nemesis figure — “In a class on Greek mythology, students may learn how a Nemesis figure represents retribution against excessive pride.”**

quiz.question: ____ __ Genesis
quiz.explanation: 起源; 创世纪, 创世纪. The book of Genesis describes the creation of the world. 创世纪描述了世界的创造。 | genesis->起源（希腊gignesthai->产生），genesis->起源（cf. gene基因，genetics遗传学） || 文化联想：Genesis 是《圣经》的《创世纪》，可用中国学生学习西方宗教文化时来记忆，可以说 **the book of Genesis — “A Chinese student studying Western religious traditions may read that the book of Genesis opens with an account of creation.”**

quiz.question: apotheosis __ ___
quiz.explanation: 神化; 典范, 艺术的典范. The painting represents the apotheosis of art in that era. 这幅画代表了那个时代艺术的典范。 | apo->提升，theos->神（希腊），apotheosis->提升到神的地位=神化/典范（cf. theology神学） || 文化联想：中文“被捧上神坛”最适合帮助记忆 apotheosis，可以说 **the apotheosis of a hero — “A political movement that portrays one leader as flawless may approach the apotheosis of a hero.”**

quiz.question: ______ symbiosis
quiz.explanation: 共生, 互惠共生. Bees and flowers have a mutual symbiosis relationship. 蜜蜂和花朵有互惠共生关系。 | sym->共同，bios->生命（希腊），symbiosis->共同生活=共生（cf. biology生物学） || 文化联想：蜜蜂与花朵互相受益最适合帮助记忆 symbiosis，可以说 **mutual symbiosis — “Bees receive nectar while flowers gain pollination, creating a familiar example of mutual symbiosis.”**

quiz.question: _______ osmosis
quiz.explanation: 渗透, 反渗透. The water purification system uses reverse osmosis technology. 净水系统使用反渗透技术。 | osmos->推/冲（希腊），osmosis->通过膜渗透=渗透（cf. by osmosis不知不觉地学会） || 文化联想：中国家用净水器里的反渗透最适合帮助记忆 osmosis，可以说 **reverse osmosis — “A home water purifier may use reverse osmosis to remove dissolved salts and other impurities.”**

quiz.question: _______ prognosis
quiz.explanation: 预后; 预测, 医学预后. The doctor gave a positive medical prognosis for recovery. 医生给出了积极的康复医学预后。 | pro->提前，gnosis->知识（希腊），prognosis->提前知晓=预后（cf. diagnosis诊断） || 文化联想：中文医院里的“预后”最适合帮助记忆 prognosis，可以说 **a medical prognosis — “After reviewing test results, a doctor may give a medical prognosis about the likely course of recovery.”**

quiz.question: _______ neurosis
quiz.explanation: 神经症, 焦虑神经症. The patient was diagnosed with anxiety neurosis. 患者被诊断患有焦虑神经症。 | neuro->神经（希腊neuron），osis->疾病状态，neurosis->神经的疾病状态=神经症 || 文化联想：neurosis 是较旧的心理学术语，可用中国心理学课堂来记忆，可以说 **an anxiety neurosis — “In an older psychology text, a persistent anxiety condition may be described as an anxiety neurosis.”**

quiz.question: ___ __ ellipsis
quiz.explanation: 省略号, 使用省略号. Writers use an ellipsis to indicate omitted text. 作家使用省略号来表示省略的文本。 | elleipsis->缺失（希腊），ellipsis->省去文字=省略号（cf. ellipse椭圆=缺了一块的圆） || 文化联想：中文写作里的“……”最适合帮助记忆 ellipsis，可以说 **use an ellipsis — “A writer may use an ellipsis to show that words have been omitted from a quotation.”**

quiz.question: ____ synopsis
quiz.explanation: 概要; 梗概, 情节梗概. The publisher requested a plot synopsis of the novel. 出版商要求提供小说的情节梗概。 | syn->共同，opsis->看（希腊），synopsis->一起看=概览/梗概 || 文化联想：中国学生给小说写情节梗概最适合帮助记忆 synopsis，可以说 **a plot synopsis — “A student may write a plot synopsis that summarizes the main events of a novel without retelling every detail.”**

quiz.question: _________ catharsis
quiz.explanation: 宣泄; 净化, 情感宣泄. The therapy session provided emotional catharsis for her. 治疗过程为她提供了情感宣泄。 | katharsis->净化（希腊katharos->纯洁），catharsis->净化情感=宣泄 || 文化联想：看一场悲情电影后痛哭一场、情绪得到释放最适合帮助记忆 catharsis，可以说 **emotional catharsis — “A moving film may provide emotional catharsis by allowing viewers to cry and release pent-up feelings.”**

quiz.question: _____ ecdysis
quiz.explanation: 蜕皮, 蛇蜕皮. Snake ecdysis occurs several times per year. 蛇蜕皮每年发生多次。 | ek->出，dysis->潜入（希腊），ecdysis->从旧皮中出来=蜕皮 || 文化联想：蛇蜕皮最适合帮助记忆 ecdysis，可以说 **snake ecdysis — “During snake ecdysis, the animal sheds its old outer skin as its body grows.”**

quiz.question: ____ gratis
quiz.explanation: 免费的, 免费. The software is available free gratis to students. 该软件免费提供给学生。 | gratis->出于感激/免费（拉丁gratia->恩惠），gratis->免费（cf. gratitude感激） || 文化联想：中文“免费赠送”最适合帮助记忆 gratis，可以说 **provided gratis — “A museum may provide an educational booklet gratis to visiting students.”**

quiz.question: _____ nephritis
quiz.explanation: 肾炎, 急性肾炎. The patient was hospitalized with acute nephritis. 患者因急性肾炎住院。 | nephros->肾（希腊），itis->炎症，nephritis->肾脏炎症=肾炎 || 文化联想：中国医院肾内科治疗急性肾炎最适合帮助记忆 nephritis，可以说 **acute nephritis — “A patient with acute nephritis may need hospital care to monitor kidney function and inflammation.”**

quiz.question: __________ arthritis
quiz.explanation: 关节炎, 类风湿性关节炎. Rheumatoid arthritis causes joint inflammation and pain. 类风湿性关节炎导致关节炎症和疼痛。 | arthron->关节（希腊），itis->炎症，arthritis->关节炎症=关节炎 || 文化联想：中文“类风湿关节炎”最适合帮助记忆 arthritis，可以说 **rheumatoid arthritis — “Rheumatoid arthritis can cause persistent pain, swelling, and stiffness in multiple joints.”**

quiz.question: _______ gastritis
quiz.explanation: 胃炎, 慢性胃炎. Chronic gastritis can damage the stomach lining. 慢性胃炎会损害胃粘膜。 | gaster->胃（希腊），itis->炎症，gastritis->胃炎（cf. gastronomy美食学） || 文化联想：中国人常说“胃炎”，最适合帮助记忆 gastritis，可以说 **chronic gastritis — “A patient with chronic gastritis may experience recurring upper-abdominal discomfort and inflammation of the stomach lining.”**

quiz.question: _____ hepatitis
quiz.explanation: 肝炎, 病毒性肝炎. Viral hepatitis can be prevented through vaccination. 病毒性肝炎可以通过疫苗接种预防。 | hepat->肝（希腊hepar），itis->炎症，hepatitis->肝脏炎症=肝炎 || 文化联想：中国公共卫生宣传里的病毒性肝炎最适合帮助记忆 hepatitis，可以说 **viral hepatitis — “Vaccination and infection-control measures can prevent some forms of viral hepatitis.”**

quiz.question: axis __ ________
quiz.explanation: 轴; 轴线, 旋转轴. Earth spins on its axis of rotation. 地球绕其旋转轴自转。 | axis->轴（拉丁，来自agere->驱动），axis->旋转轴（cf. axle车轴，axiom公理） || 文化联想：中国地理课讲地球自转轴最适合帮助记忆 axis，可以说 **the axis of rotation — “Earth spins around an imaginary axis of rotation running through the North and South Poles.”**

quiz.question: __________ annals
quiz.explanation: 编年史; 年鉴, 历史编年史. The event is recorded in the historical annals. 该事件记录在历史编年史中。 | annus->年（拉丁），annals->按年记录的史书=编年史（cf. annual年度的，anniversary周年） || 文化联想：《史记》《资治通鉴》等史书最适合帮助记忆 annals，可以说 **historical annals — “Major events of dynastic history were preserved in historical annals for later generations to study.”**

quiz.question: ____ alms
quiz.explanation: 施舍; 救济金, 施舍. The monks would give alms to the poor. 僧侣会向穷人施舍。 | eleemosyne->怜悯（希腊），alms->慈悲施舍（注意l不发音，cf. eleemosynary慈善的） || 文化联想：佛教寺院或传统慈善场景里的布施最适合帮助记忆 alms，可以说 **give alms — “A visitor may give alms to support people in need as an act of charity and compassion.”**

quiz.question: ____ qualms
quiz.explanation: 疑虑; 不安, 有疑虑. I have qualms about accepting such a large gift. 我对接受这么大的礼物有疑虑。 | qualm->良心不安（古英语cwealm->死亡），qualms->良心上的疑虑 || 文化联想：中文“心里犯嘀咕”最适合帮助记忆 qualms，可以说 **have qualms — “Someone asked to accept an unusually expensive gift may have qualms about whether doing so is appropriate.”**

quiz.question: __ ___ doldrums
quiz.explanation: 忧郁; 停滞, 处于停滞状态. The economy has been in the doldrums for months. 经济已经处于停滞状态好几个月了。 | doldrums->赤道无风带（风平浪静船停），in the doldrums->处于停滞/忧郁 || 文化联想：中文“经济低迷、死气沉沉”最适合帮助记忆 doldrums，可以说 **in the doldrums — “A housing market with weak sales and little investment may remain in the doldrums for months.”**

quiz.question: _____ remains
quiz.explanation: 遗骸; 残余, 人类遗骸. Archaeologists discovered ancient human remains at the site. 考古学家在现场发现了古代人类遗骸。 | re->继续，main->留（拉丁manere），remains->留下来的=遗骸/残余 || 文化联想：中国考古发现古代人类遗骸最适合帮助记忆 remains，可以说 **human remains — “Archaeologists may carefully document human remains found at an ancient burial site.”**

quiz.question: ____ environs
quiz.explanation: 周围地区; 郊区, 城市周围地区. They explored the city environs on their day off. 他们在休息日探索了城市周围地区。 | environ->围绕（法语），environs->围绕城市的地区=郊区（cf. environment环境） || 文化联想：中文“城市周边地区”最适合帮助记忆 environs，可以说 **the city environs — “A traveler may explore the city environs to visit villages, parks, and historic sites outside the urban center.”**

quiz.question: ___ kudos
quiz.explanation: 荣誉; 赞扬, 赢得赞扬. The team will win kudos for their outstanding performance. 团队将因其出色表现赢得赞扬。 | kydos->荣耀（希腊），kudos->荣耀/赞誉（注意：kudos是单数） || 文化联想：中文“赢得一片赞誉”最适合帮助记忆 kudos，可以说 **win kudos — “A rescue team may win kudos for responding quickly and professionally after a major flood.”**

quiz.question: ________ pathos
quiz.explanation: 悲情; 感染力, 感人的悲情. The speech was filled with touching pathos. 演讲充满了感人的悲情。 | pathos->受苦/情感（希腊），pathos->引起怜悯的情感=悲情（cf. sympathy同情，empathy共情） || 文化联想：《红楼梦》里许多悲剧场景最适合帮助记忆 pathos，可以说 **deep pathos — “The decline of the Jia family in Dream of the Red Chamber is filled with deep pathos as relationships and hopes gradually collapse.”**

quiz.question: _____ ethos
quiz.explanation: 气质; 精神, 希腊精神. Ancient Greek ethos emphasized virtue and excellence. 古希腊精神强调美德和卓越。 | ethos->品格/习惯（希腊），ethos->群体的气质精神（cf. ethnic民族的，ethics伦理） || 文化联想：中文“一个群体长期形成的精神气质”最适合帮助记忆 ethos，可以说 **a cultural ethos — “Respect for education can become part of a cultural ethos when families and institutions reinforce it across generations.”**

quiz.question: apropos ______
quiz.explanation: 适当的; 恰当的, 恰当的评论. She made an apropos remark about the situation. 她对这种情况发表了恰当的评论。 | à propos->关于/恰当（法语），apropos->恰到好处的（cf. propose提议） || 文化联想：中文“这句话说得正合时宜”最适合帮助记忆 apropos，可以说 **an apropos remark — “At a discussion about thrift, a timely reference to ‘勤俭持家’ would be an apropos remark.”**

quiz.question: ____ __ pincers
quiz.explanation: 钳子; 螯, 一把钳子. The crab used its pair of pincers defensively. 螃蟹用它的一对螯进行防御。 | pincer->夹取（古法语pincier->夹），pincers->夹取工具（pincer movement->钳形攻势） || 文化联想：螃蟹用一对螯夹东西最适合帮助记忆 pincers，可以说 **a pair of pincers — “A crab may raise a pair of pincers defensively when it feels threatened.”**

quiz.question: _______ bleachers
quiz.explanation: 看台, 体育场看台. Fans filled the stadium bleachers to watch the game. 球迷挤满了体育场看台观看比赛。 | bleach->漂白，bleachers->在太阳下被晒白的木板看台=露天看台 || 文化联想：中国体育场看台最适合帮助记忆 bleachers，可以说 **stadium bleachers — “Fans may fill the stadium bleachers during a school athletics meet.”**

quiz.question: ____ __ pliers
quiz.explanation: 钳子, 一把钳子. Use a pair of pliers to grip the wire tightly. 使用一把钳子紧紧抓住电线。 | plier->折叠者（法语plier->折叠），pliers->能弯折的夹具=钳子 || 文化联想：家里修电线时常用钳子夹紧或弯折金属线，最适合帮助记忆 pliers，可以说 **a pair of pliers — “A homeowner may use a pair of pliers to grip and bend a piece of wire.”**

quiz.question: _______ calipers
quiz.explanation: 卡尺, 游标卡尺. The engineer measured with Vernier calipers for precision. 工程师用游标卡尺进行精确测量。 | caliber->口径（阿拉伯语qalib->模具），calipers->测量口径的工具=卡尺 || 文化联想：中国工程师用游标卡尺测零件尺寸最适合帮助记忆 calipers，可以说 **Vernier calipers — “A machinist may use Vernier calipers to measure the diameter of a metal part precisely.”**

quiz.question: ____ nippers
quiz.explanation: 指甲钳; 钳子, 指甲钳. She trimmed her nails with nail nippers. 她用指甲钳修剪指甲。 | nip->夹住（象声词），nippers->夹取工具=钳子（cf. nip in the bud扼杀在萌芽） || 文化联想：家里修指甲或维修细小零件时用小钳子最适合帮助记忆 nippers，可以说 **nail nippers — “Someone trimming a thick toenail may use nail nippers for better control.”**

quiz.question: _____ compass
quiz.explanation: 指南针; 罗盘, 道德指南针. A strong moral compass guides ethical decisions. 强大的道德指南针指导道德决策。 | com->共同，pass->步（拉丁passus），compass->绕行一圈=指南针/包围（cf. compassion同情） || 文化联想：中文“道德指南针”最适合帮助记忆 compass，可以说 **a moral compass — “A strong moral compass helps a person choose what is right even when no one is watching.”**

quiz.question: encompass ___
quiz.explanation: 包含; 包围, 包含全部. The study aims to encompass all relevant factors. 该研究旨在包含所有相关因素。 | en->使，compass->绕行一圈，encompass->用圈子围住=包含 || 文化联想：中文“把所有因素都包括进去”最适合帮助记忆 encompass，可以说 **encompass all factors — “A serious housing analysis should encompass all factors, including price, location, financing, taxes, and maintenance.”**

quiz.question: surpass ____________
quiz.explanation: 超过; 胜过, 超过期望. The product sales will surpass expectations this quarter. 本季度产品销售将超过期望。 | sur->超过，pass->通过，surpass->超越通过=胜过（cf. bypass绕过） || 文化联想：中文“超出预期”最适合帮助记忆 surpass，可以说 **surpass expectations — “A new product may surpass expectations if sales, reviews, and customer retention all exceed the forecast.”**

quiz.question: harass _ _______
quiz.explanation: 骚扰; 困扰, 骚扰证人. It is illegal to harass a witness in a legal case. 在法律案件中骚扰证人是非法的。 | harer->放犬追猎（古法语），harass->像猎犬一样追逐骚扰 || 文化联想：中文“骚扰证人”最适合帮助记忆 harass，可以说 **harass a witness — “It is improper and often illegal to harass a witness in an attempt to change testimony.”**

quiz.question: crass ______
quiz.explanation: 粗鲁的; 愚钝的, 粗鲁的评论. His crass remark offended everyone at dinner. 他粗鲁的评论冒犯了晚餐上的所有人。 | crassus->粗/厚（拉丁），crass->厚实愚钝的=粗鲁的 || 文化联想：中文“粗俗又没分寸的话”最适合帮助记忆 crass，可以说 **a crass remark — “Making a crude joke at a solemn family ceremony would be a crass remark.”**

quiz.question: ____________ morass
quiz.explanation: 沼泽; 困境, 官僚困境. The project got stuck in a bureaucratic morass. 该项目陷入了官僚困境。 | moeras->沼泽（荷兰语），morass->沼泽/困境 || 文化联想：中文“陷进官僚泥潭”最适合帮助记忆 morass，可以说 **a bureaucratic morass — “A small project can become trapped in a bureaucratic morass when approvals, forms, and overlapping rules never seem to end.”**

quiz.question: embarrass ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 使尴尬; 使窘迫, 使主人尴尬. Do not embarrass the host with inappropriate questions. 不要用不恰当的问题使主人尴尬。 | embaraçar->阻碍（葡萄牙语），embarrass->像被栏杆卡住一样=使尴尬 || 文化联想：中文“当众让主人下不来台”最适合帮助记忆 embarrass，可以说 **embarrass the host — “Asking an intrusive question at a formal banquet may embarrass the host in front of all the guests.”**

quiz.question: canvass ______
quiz.explanation: 游说; 拉票, 游说选民. Campaign workers canvass voters door to door. 竞选工作人员挨家挨户游说选民。 | canvas->帆布（用帆布过滤），canvass->仔细筛查/游说（注意双写ss） || 文化联想：中文“挨家挨户拉票”最适合帮助记忆 canvass，可以说 **canvass voters — “Campaign volunteers may canvass voters door to door to explain a candidate’s position and ask for support.”**
